title: The tower
steps: Months have passed, and it is the last day of the year. Your trunks are half packed. And you, {wizard}, fly with Arvelia's broom racing team now!
The three of you still keep your secret… you have kept it the whole year.
{friend} keeps the black threads in a little box, and often carries it about so that nobody finds it by accident.
The cold voice has not been heard again, and the pupil who spoke with it always avoids you: he turns down another corridor whenever he sees you.
Today is the last class of the year: Conjuring, with Orla, in the highest hall of the castle.
You all leave the dormitory: you do not want to be late.
Zarek steps in front of you in the entrance hall. Today he has lost another race to you, and there was a bet: the loser would answer any question the winner asked.
I very nearly won today's race, you know. I'm sure {wizard} has cheated again.
Drop it, Zarek. We don't cheat, and you know it. And now, keep your side of the bet!
All right, all right. Calm down. Well, what question do you want answered?
Who is that boy with the messy fair hair who never flies?
We saw him by the field's gate on the day of the first race.
The one who never flies, you say? Him? Rinlo, from my year. You wouldn't get him on a broom if you tied him to it.
So his name is Rinlo! Listen, I think it is important that we say something.
We ought to talk to Orla this very day.
But what do we tell her? A few black threads prove nothing, however bad a feeling they give us.
Well, let's go to Conjuring class. I don't want Orla to scold me again: I'm hopeless at it!
You climb the long winding stair to the highest hall of the castle: a circle in the floor, an enormous book on a lectern, and Bimo asleep beside the book.
This is perhaps the most important day of the first year. Today each of you is given a familiar.
You look round: there is not a single creature.
Do not look for them: you will not find them here yet.
A familiar is not chosen: it is conjured. And for that, the first thing is to describe it.
What you describe, the spell *minka* will call into the circle.
In there it is only a trial: it is not alive, and it comes undone by itself. Try as often as you like.
As first-years, you are allowed to conjure six kinds of creature, in their natural colours.
If you take a creature out of the circle, it will have a soul, and it will live. That cannot be undone.
You may not take any creature out of the circle…
…until you are sure it is the one you want as your familiar.
And I shall look over your descriptions and your conjurings first.
"What if I don't like any of them?" whispers {mate}.
Miaow.
